entities.name: Ilona
entities.description: Orzhov potentate and kingpin leading one of the Syndicate's cartels.

entities.name: Orzhov Syndicate
entities.description: Ravnican guild whose cartels Ilona leads.

entities.name: Bilagru
entities.description: Executioner hired by Ilona to claim lives of debtors.

entities.name: Symond Halm
entities.description: Playwright who borrowed gold from Ilona for a play and risked his life.

entities.name: Azorius prison
entities.description: Prison where Symond hid after killing a vedalken.

events.summary: Ilona had Symond Halm sign a contract that put his life on the line should his play fail.
events.quote: she had him sign a contract that put his life on the line should he fail.

events.summary: Ilona and Lord Kazmyr watched the poorly attended premiere and sent Kazmyr and Bilagru after Symond.
events.quote: Ilona sent Lord Kazmyr and Bilagru to follow him.

events.summary: Symond killed a vedalken to be imprisoned; Ilona resolved to claim his debt even by breaking into an Azorius prison.
events.quote: Symond killed a vedalken man to be put into prison
